Ayesha: something that can only be described with superlatives

Happy birthday Ayesha!

Hope you have a great, great day, and may this birthday surprise you with gifts, even though it is very unlikely. I just wanted to say thank youuu for everything. Thank youuu for all the good moments that you brought into my life and for always being so considerate with me. I treasure those moments more than you know. It is my utmost privilege to be a part of your life, and I’m grateful for every bit of it. I hope your day is as wonderful as you are, and may you be rewarded with everything you ever wish for. May your life be filled with lots and lots and lots of happiness and contentment. I wish your life turns out exactly as you want it to be, always. Lastly Ayesha, I just wanna add that being known by you, out of billions of people, is the greatest blessing of my life. Anyway keep on slaying and stay the coolest always.

Take Care
A Friend to be (Pending)
